params.body:
## What

The designer sent a new hero (maquette of 23 September) and a verdict on colour:

> I think i'm sick of the blue it's too much. [...] i still like the part with the numbers and the part with the information: the trending now section, it gave a journalistic side. [...] the black is not a 100% black, this is the code: #1d1d1b. [...] a black and white website is always more elegant but we need to keep the blue touch without an overdose of blue.

She also sent the hero image itself, in grey.

## The hero

- The home carries the **normal bar** again, with the logo in her black. The split hero, the mint panel that was the navigation, and the hidden bar that slid in after the numbers (`sticky-bar.js`) are gone.
- Her **collage band**, edge to edge, in grey. Under 768 px a taller cut from the same band, around the word youth.
- The **colour under the cursor** stays: same mask, same drift at rest, same script.
- A **black band** (#1d1d1b) under it: *Read,* understand, *activate* in mint, the introduction in white, the two calls on the right (mint and white), and "Youth culture." in the dot letter, in mint.

**Her grey, not a filter.** Her file is 1702 px wide, too soft for the width. It was found back in `MAIN COLLAGE-1.jpg` (offset 4, 3456; 3236 × 930, correlation 0.85), recut at 2800 px, and turned grey with a tone curve fitted from her file against the colour version. So the grey is her tone, and the colour layer lies on it pixel for pixel, which is what makes the reveal line up.

## Blue as a touch

- `--color-ink` and `--color-night` are her black, `#1D1D1B`, and so are the mails.
- Black instead of green or mint: the footer, the phone menu, the bar under a post.
- Stone instead of mint: the newsletter panel, the post card.
- Green stays as the touch: the button, "Create a free account", the icons.
- Untouched, as she asked: the numbers band and "Trending now".
- The holding page (what gentells.com shows today) gets the black logo too.

`BRAND.md` records all of it, including what is left: the mint surfaces on the subpages she has not drawn (the highlighted plan, the account, the reading room, the filters), and the layout under the hero, which she says will follow.

## Checked

Locally: the build, ESLint, the Tailwind class check, Pint and the PHP suite pass. `HeroCollageTest` now pins the new hero: the normal bar above it, both layers present on every screen width, the preload and reserved size, and **no mint panel on the home page** (checked by putting the mint newsletter back once: the test fails). `OneVoiceTest` follows the logo to its black file. The OAuth browser round trip runs in CI.
params.title: The hero of 23 September: her band, her black, and blue as a touch
